newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk oil port reopens as winds drop.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk oil port reopens as winds drop.

text.p: The Russian Black Sea oil port of Novorossiisk reopened on Friday morning after a day's closure due to high winds and heavy swell, a shipping source said.
The port, which has been closed several times over the last week, reopened at 0200 hours local time.

One large crude tanker was loading at the main berth one on Friday morning, while another was waiting at anchor. Another smaller crude tanker was loading at berth two and four others were waiting to load.
A gas oil tanker was loading at berth three and another was at anchor, the source said.
